initial_source_scope.assessment: The question explicitly requests annual segment disclosures. Initial S2/S3 instead come from FY2024 Q2/Q3 10-Qs. S2 includes the older cryptocurrency mining processors segment description; S3 reports interim revenues, not the requested annual values. The final answer uses annual S1/S5/S6 and does not propagate either interim table or obsolete product detail. This is a remaining form-scope retrieval failure, not a final finance/period error.

summary.finding: All four answers are useful and preserve reported periods, conditional versus completed events, licensing versus product channels, and segment versus market reporting. No material unsupported value, derived arithmetic, false event timing, or wrong period/version was found. One fixed reference detail (licensees manufacturing cellular products) is implicit rather than explicit; this does not defeat the requested relationship distinction. A remaining initial scope failure returns two interim 10-Q chunks for the explicitly annual FY2024 segment question; the final answer correctly uses annual evidence. Correct document identities also do not establish topical relevance of every passage. Four cases with one capture each provide bounded held-out evidence, not a broad reliability estimate or causal proof of the retrieval refinement.
